title: Low-Dose Aspirin Use Associated with Lower Ovarian Cancer Risk

sections.abstract: <jats:p> <jats:bold>According to this study:</jats:bold> </jats:p> <jats:p> <jats:list list-type="bullet"><jats:list-item><jats:p>Regular use of low-dose aspirin is associated with a lower risk of ovarian cancer.</jats:p></jats:list-item><jats:list-item><jats:p>Long-term, high-quantity use of nonaspirin analgesics may increase ovarian cancer risk.</jats:p></jats:list-item></jats:list> </jats:p>
